## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in Advanced SEO: AEO, GEO & AI Search, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. What is Answer Engine Optimisation concerned with?
+ Being used as the answer an engine gives, not only ranking in a list of links
- Buying placement inside AI results
- Blocking AI crawlers from the site
= AEO optimises for being extracted and cited inside a generated answer.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

## Marking rubric

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
- Correct use of the method taught in this module — 30 marks
